definitions.explanation: The process of something becoming more advanced, sophisticated, or elevated in quality or complexity. Often used for technology, systems, and methods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高度化|こうどか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高度化|こうどか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選択肢|せんたくし}→選択肢：14418_sentakushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The advancement of medicine has increased treatment options.

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦セキュリティ→セキュリティ：04867_sekyuriti⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高度化|こうどか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急務|きゅうむ}→急務：21059_kyuumu⟧だ。
examples.english: Training specialized personnel is urgent to keep up with the increasing sophistication of information security.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧ (advanced, high-level) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (-ization). Part of the productive ～⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ pattern that creates nouns/suru-verbs meaning "the process of becoming ~." Common in news, business, and academic contexts when discussing modernization and technological progress.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高度化|こうどか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become more advanced
- {高度化|こうどか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: advancement progresses
- {高度化|こうどか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to respond to increasing sophistication

SIMILAR WORDS (～⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ pattern):
- ⟦{複雑化|ふくざつか}→複雑化：21265_fukuzatsuka⟧: complication — becoming more complex (negative nuance)
- ⟦{多様化|たようか}→多様化：07564_tayouka⟧: diversification — becoming more varied
- ⟦{効率化|こうりつか}→効率化：07565_kouritsuka⟧: streamlining — becoming more efficient
